svg.text: 25 mm reinforcing bar, 830 mm long; grind one end to a point.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Washer: 50 mm disc of 6 mm plate, 26 mm hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide the washer on; weld it, underside 30 mm below the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each sleeper with a 28 mm hole, 400 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of its middle, before setting it out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drive the stake through the sleeper until the washer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bears on the timber: 700 mm goes into the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In rock or hard laterite, drill a pilot hole first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stake does not move when pulled by hand.
